chunks: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will be warned?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Qur'an was made easy for dhikr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine ease (Yassarna) of the Qur'an, contrasting the accessibility of its message with the spiritual hardness of those who reject it, as seen in the preceding verses regarding the people of Noah and 'Ad. It serves as a call to active contemplation (Tadabbur), emphasizing that the barrier to guidance is not textual complexity but the reader's willingness to internalize the lessons (Dhikr). This reflects the Imami view that the Qur'an is a clear guide for all who seek truth with sincerity.
